mentions.name: Urban Dictionary Semantic Search
mentions.description: A semantic search engine for Urban Dictionary that lets users search slang phrases the youth keeps redefining, with a goal of finding words originating from a given city without returning mismatched results. It uses embedding models (currently nomic-embed-text) to build vectors from definitions.
mentions.problem: Some Urban Dictionary definitions are very low quality, making it hard to get enriched vectors, and it's difficult to find a good open source embedding model.
mentions.source_excerpt: A semantic search engine for urban dictionary to be able to search for stupid phrases that the youth keeps redefining
